[[File:Umbrella_TPM.png|thumb|right|200px|A Podrace spectator using an umbrella]]
An '''umbrella''' was an object used by individuals throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for protection against rain or [[Star/Legends|sunshine]].

A [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]], serving in the [[High Orbit Precision Entry Squad]], used an umbrella to land safely during an orbital insertion to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yorn Skot]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Drop">{{CWACite|6|The Drop (comic story)}}</ref>
